n = int(input())
k = int(input())

MOD = 10**9 + 7

class Matrix:
    MAXN = 32
    def __init__(self):
        self.N = 0
        self.a = [[0]*self.MAXN for _ in range(self.MAXN)]
    def initialize(self, _N, _V):
        self.N = _N
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.N):
                self.a[i][j] = _V
    def matrix_multiply(self, b):
        temp = Matrix()
        temp.N = self.N
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.N):
                t = 0
                for k in range(self.N):
                    t += self.a[i][k] * b.a[k][j]
                temp.a[i][j] = t % MOD
        self.a = temp.a

A = [[Matrix() for _ in range(32)] for _ in range(64)]
prefix = [[Matrix() for _ in range(32)] for _ in range(64)]
suffix = [[Matrix() for _ in range(32)] for _ in range(64)]

def precompute_values(index):
    prefix[index][1] = A[index][0]
    for j in range(2, k+1):
        prefix[index][j] = prefix[index][j - 1]
        prefix[index][j].matrix_multiply(A[index][j - 1])
    suffix[index][k - 1] = A[index][k - 1]
    for j in range(k - 2, -1, -1):
        suffix[index][j] = A[index][j]
        suffix[index][j].matrix_multiply(suffix[index][j + 1])

def sum_digits(number):
    total = 0
    while number:
        total += number % k
        total %= k
        number //= k
    return total

def get_result(number, m):
    if number < k:
        res = A[m][0]
        for i in range(1, number):
            res.matrix_multiply(A[m][i])
        return res
    res = get_result(number // k, m + 1)
    x = sum_digits(number // k)
    for i in range(number % k):
        res.matrix_multiply(A[m][(x + i) % k])
    return res

# Initialize A[0][i]
for i in range(k):
    A[0][i] = Matrix()
    A[0][i].initialize(k + 1, 0)
    for j in range(k + 1):
        A[0][i].a[j][j] = 1
        A[0][i].a[j][i] = 1

m = 1
while (k ** m) - 1000 <= n:
    precompute_values(m - 1)
    for x in range(k):
        A[m][x] = suffix[m - 1][x]
        if x > 0:
            A[m][x].matrix_multiply(prefix[m - 1][x])
    m += 1

finalMat = get_result(n, 0)
totalAns = 0
for i in range(k + 1):
    totalAns += finalMat.a[k][i]
totalAns %= MOD
print(totalAns)
